correctness.rationale: Exact private-witness criterion follows from disjoint row/column neighborhood counts. It gives an exhaustive disjoint trichotomy: star forests with an isolated vertex on each side or nonsurjective row/column maps. Labeled exponential formula counts uniquely assigned components, assigning each single-edge component to a row center. Inclusion/exclusion counts non-surjections. The stable-range edge-count bound p+q-k and equality restrictions prove a unique perpendicular two-star form. Independent direct neighborhood subset enumeration matches every coefficient for seven small boards, and all 177100 size-six omission sets on 5x5 yield exactly 400 structured optima. The finite checks are corroboration, not the proof.

value.rationale: The complete cardinality enumerator for the natural rook-graph family resolves feasible guard placements at all sizes and refines the known minimum-number theorem. The star-forest/nonsurjection structural split is nontrivial; the stable-range unique orbit and exact count m(m-1)n(n-1) of all minimum placements adds genuine geometric rigidity and direct combinatorial interpretation. This is a two-parameter non-routine exact classification, not a trivial substitution of the known scalar formula.
